sample_unit: emergency medicine consultants and residents (survey responses)

links.outcome: Proportion of emergency clinicians who had received formal AI training
links.effect: Only 14.2% had received formal training; 88.2% had basic AI understanding; 64.5% named training as the most critical support need.
links.quote: Most respondents had a basic understanding of AI (88.2 %) and were aware of AI applications in emergency medicine (73.2 %), yet only 14.2 % had received formal training.

links.outcome: Institutions having a formal AI implementation strategy
links.effect: Only 12.0% of respondents indicated their institution had a formal AI implementation strategy.
links.quote: Only12.0 % indicated that their institution had a formal AI implementation strategy.

screen.reason: Empirical survey/mixed-methods study investigating perceptions, experiences, barriers, and readiness for AI adoption among emergency medicine clinicians in Sub-Saharan Africa.
